'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2023 Eritrean clashes in Tel Aviv]]
**Clashes occur in [[Tel Aviv]], [[Israel]], between [[Eritrea]]n [[asylum seeker]]s, including supporters opponents of the [[politics of Eritrea|government]] of [[Isaias Afwerki]], and [[Israeli police|police]], resulting in 84 demonstrators and 30 officers injured, with 68 arrested. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-66694149 (BBC News)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[2022–2023 western Russia attacks]]
***The [[Ministry of Defence (Russia)|Russian Defense Ministry]] says that it has destroyed 281 Ukrainian drones in the past week, including 29 over western Russia. [https://www.scmp.com/news/world/russia-central-asia/article/3233163/russia-says-it-destroyed-281-ukrainian-drones-week-shelling-continues-apace-and-troops-step-pressure (''South China Morning Post'')]
**[[Crimea attacks (2022–present)|Crimea attacks]]
***The [[Ministry of Defence (Russia)|Russian Defense Ministry]] says that it has thwarted attacks on the [[Crimean Bridge]] by destroying a [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] boat. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-defence-ministry-says-boat-destroyed-trying-attack-crimea-bridge-2023-09-01/ (Reuters)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Battle of Khartoum (2023–2025)|Battle of Khartoum]]
***An airstrike in the [[Kalakla|Kalakla al-Qubba]] neighbourhood of southwest [[Khartoum]], [[Sudan]] killed 21 civilians and severely injured six. [https://sudanwarmonitor.com/p/airstrike-kills-20-civilians-at-khartoum (Sudan War Monitor)]
*[[Belarus]] says a [[Poland|Polish]] [[Polish Air Force|military]] [[Mil Mi-24|Mi-24 military helicopter]] breached its airspace, flying 1.2 km into its territory. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/belarus-says-polish-helicopter-crossed-border-warsaw-denies-it-2023-09-01/ (Reuters)]
*More than 2,000 troops from the [[Collective Security Treaty Organization|CSTO security alliance]] begin military exercises in [[Belarus]]. [https://apnews.com/article/russia-belarus-military-exercises-poland-d7fe602af6bd7cb8a01ece611effcec9 (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Greece wildfires]]
**[[Greece|Greek]] [[firefighters]] rescue a group of 25 [[Human migration|migrants]] trapped in a forest in the [[Evros (regional unit)|Evros region]]  as flames from a wildfire approached. [https://apnews.com/article/greece-wildfires-migrants-evros-884da72102fde7c9a4c18e9400b0ae27 (AP)]
*The [[Greece|Greek]] [[Hellenic Coast Guard|Coast Guard]] rescue more than 150 people, including several children, who were heading in small boats from [[Turkey]] to the nearby eastern [[Aegean Sea]] islands. [https://apnews.com/article/greece-migrants-turkey-boats-aegean-rescues-be900ea844ac385108df158fc0bdf72d (AP)]
*At least 10 people are killed after lightning strikes across [[Odisha]], [[India]]. [https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/other-states/at-least-10-people-killed-in-lightning-strikes-in-odisha/article67265963.ece (The Hindu)]
*Seven people are killed after a van collided head-on with a truck in [[Thatta district]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://tribune.com.pk/story/2433877/seven-killed-in-van-truck-collision?utm_source=chatgpt.com (Tribune)]
*Two people are killed after a roof collapse in [[Erode]], [[India]]. [https://www.thehindu.com/news/cities/Coimbatore/two-killed-in-roof-collapse-following-incessant-rains-in-erode/article67262946.ece (The Hindu)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Corruption in Ukraine]]
**A Ukrainian court places [[billionaire]] [[Ihor Kolomoyskyi]] under arrest over fraud and money laundering charges as part of corruption-related activities. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/9/2/ukraine-tycoon-ihor-kolomoisky-taken-into-custody-over-fraud-allegations (Al Jazeera)]
*Two people are killed and six others are wounded in a shooting at a wedding reception in [[Ottawa]], Ontario, Canada. [https://ottawacitizen.com/news/local-news/two-people-killed-several-injured-in-shooting-in-uplands-area (''Ottawa Citizen'')]
*[[Cyprus Police|Cypriot police]] arrest 13 people after a mob smashes storefronts and set numerous trash bins on fire during an [[anti-immigration]] march in [[Limassol]]. [https://apnews.com/article/cyprus-migrants-protest-violence-arrests-70cf7d51fcc06d79f5f74daa8c85e412 (AP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2023 Gabonese coup d'état]]
**[[Gabon]]'s [[Committee for the Transition and Restoration of Institutions|military government]] reopens the country's borders, three days after they were closed. [https://mb.com.ph/2023/9/2/gabon-reopens-borders-effective-immediately-army (AFP via ''Manila Bulletin'')]

'''Science and technology'''
